items.text: Cobalt moves to a new core banking system Saturday, December 12, 00:00 to Sunday, December 13, 12:00 (Central Time).
Posts on social media claim Cobalt is in financial trouble and tell people to take their money out before the system change. Where the claim started is not known.
Several online banks lowered their savings rates this week. The gap between their rates and Cobalt's became smaller.
A video in which a customer praises how Cobalt support solved her problem is being widely shared on TikTok.
